recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14482 unless PA or Gender Harmony makes a new decision to change the current Patient Gender and Sex model or move additional Gender Harmony IG guidance back into the base Patient narrative.
issue_request: FHIR-14482 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Patient technical correction asking whether Patient.gender may represent other kinds of gender in addition to administrative gender and asking to fix the old "In addition, to" wording. The approved resolution rewrote Patient Gender notes as Patient Gender and Sex.
initial_application: Commit 7fa7a34f97 (#14482) rewrote source/patient/patient-notes.xml with the approved Patient Gender and Sex section, clarified Administrative Gender, added separate Clinical Sex, Clinical Gender, Gender Identity, Sex assigned at Birth, and Legal Sex bullets, and removed the typo. Commit 6432ebd1cc then refined the Administrative Gender wording from "attempts to represent" to "represents".
additional_context: Later Patient Administration and Gender Harmony commits updated the same section into the current Gender Identity, Sex Parameter for Clinical Use, clinical observations about sex characteristics, Recorded Sex or Gender, Legal Sex, and Sex assigned at Birth model. Current Patient.gender links to the section, and the referenced sex/gender extension definitions are in the FHIR Extension Pack. Related audits already on the combined branch treat that later model as the current baseline.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already says Patient.gender represents administrative gender, warns against inferring specific clinical meaning without pre-coordination, and identifies other mechanisms for other sex/gender concepts. Reinstating the exact 2018 bullets would partially reverse later approved guidance.
